replies.author: Atheyna
replies.body:
[Denied] - I apologize, but your map has been denied for use on the Avicus Network and will not appear in either repository or rotations. Your map has been denied for the following reasons --
→ Too plain. How could you make it look more appealing?
→ Island size and quantity isn't excellent. Expanding the size and increasing the island quantity will enhance the gameplay greatly. 
→ The amount of void would ruin this map. This can be fixed by adding more islands or expanding your current islands. Make sure that your islands aren't too far apart.
